subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) It was held in Qatar. (b) Weather-wise, Qatar is a hot country. (c) It was the last edition where 32 teams participated. (d) Therefore, we are going to see 48 countries battling for the World Cup in 2026. (e) From the 2026 edition, 48 teams are likely to participate. (f) So, to avoid the hot weather, the tournament was scheduled in November and December. (g) A total of 32 teams participated in the tournament. (h) The 2022 FIFA World Cup, the greatest show on earth, was the 22nd edition of the Soccer World Cup. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 h a b f g c e d The 2022 FIFA World Cup, the greatest show on earth, was the 22nd edition of the Soccer World Cup. It was held in Qatar. Weather-wise, Qatar is a hot country. So, to avoid the hot weather, the tournament was scheduled in November and December. A total of 32 teams participated in the tournament. It was the last edition where 32 teams participated. From the 2026 edition, 48 teams are likely to participate. Therefore, we are going to see 48 countries battling for the World Cup in 2026.
